summary: Solowin Holdings filed a 424B5 covering up to $2.16M of Class A ordinary shares plus 5,250,000 pre-delivery shares issued directly to Streeterville Capital under a February 9, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement and September 21, 2026 side letter. Pre-Paid Purchase #3 advances $2.0M with $160K original issue discount, 8% interest, and $0.0001 per-share pre-delivery pricing. This is a structured equity-linked financing, not a special situation. Watch dilution, 9.99% ownership cap, and 85% VWAP-based share settlement mechanics.
